data.desc: Green Brick Partners, Inc (NYSE: GRBK), the third largest homebuilder in Dallas-Fort Worth , is a diversified homebuilding and land development company that operates in Texas , Georgia , and Florida . Green Brick owns five subsidiary homebuilders in Texas ( CB JENI Homes , Normandy Homes , Southgate Homes , Trophy Signature Homes , and a 90% interest in Centre Living Homes ), as well as a 50% interest in a homebuilder in Atlanta, Georgia (The Providence Group ) and an 80% interest in a homebuilder in Port St. Lucie, Florida ( GHO Homes ). Green Brick also retains interests in related financial services platforms, including Green Brick Title , GRBK Mortgage, and Green Brick Insurance . Green Brick is engaged in all aspects of the homebuilding process, including land acquisition and development, entitlements, design, construction, marketing, and sales for its residential neighborhoods and master-planned communities.
